positions.name: OwnedVsRentedIntelligence
positions.frame: How should we locate the durable asset when the substrate becomes a commodity — owned versus rented intelligence?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same directional read: they oppose owned to rented intelligence and reclassify the substrate as commodity while elevating perspective as the retained asset. The value and register dimensions independently converge on this pair — self-origination versus dependence, rendered as aphoristic technical maxims. The two statements are in mutual reinforcement rather than tension: src-1 draws the owned/rented distinction, src-2 names what is worth keeping under that distinction.
